coffee_pos.name: Coffee POS
coffee_pos.desc: Developed a scalable POS system, modernizing manual store management. Reduced cashier checkout times by 50%, guaranteed 100% real-time inventory precision, and delivered actionable revenue insights via interactive analytics dashboards

edupath.name: Edupath
edupath.desc: Developed a scalable course registration and management platform empowering instructors to publish content and students to seamlessly enroll and track learning progress. Built high-performance REST APIs with Spring Boot, responsive UI using React, and modeled efficient database schemas with Oracle.
